pedagogical_depth.notes: All five cognitive levels are well represented. Concept cards and descriptors cover surface recall, cloze deletions provide contextual recall, multiple-choice cards exercise discrimination, reverse cards test identification from descriptions or nicknames, and bidirectional cards for synonym pairs cover association. The deck is pedagogically comprehensive.
